report.explanation: Current gateway telemetry contradicts the alert: traces show a 62ms OK checkout, metrics show 0.1% error rate and p95 80ms, logs show 200/ok, and no dependency timeouts or pool waiters. No evidence supports any taxonomy cause, and downstream services (order, payment, inventory, postgresql, redis) have no observations. Handing off for downstream telemetry.
